online.title: CTTIme: reporting to the company collector
online.text: This managed device is sending its monitoring data to the company collector again. Nothing collected during the gap was deleted; it was buffered on this device and is being uploaded now.

offline.title: CTTIme: cannot reach the collector
offline.text: This managed device cannot reach the company collector right now. It keeps buffering data locally on this machine and will upload it when the connection returns. Read the notice with: CTTImeAgent.exe what-collects

unverified.title: CTTIme: the collector could not be verified
unverified.text: Something answered the company collector address with a certificate this device was not told to trust. Nothing is uploaded until IT fixes it. The address and fingerprint are in this device's agent log.

registered.title: CTTIme: this device is registered
registered.text: Your acknowledgment of the monitoring notice was sent to the company collector and this device is now registered. Nothing at all is collected until an administrator approves it. Read the notice again: CTTImeAgent.exe what-collects

approved.title: CTTIme: monitoring is now active on this device
approved.text: An administrator approved this device. It has started sending screenshots, browser extension inventory and clipboard metrics on the schedule set by IT. What exactly, and how often: CTTImeAgent.exe what-collects

collecting.title: CTTIme: collection summary
collecting.text: Since this agent started {since} ago it sent {screenshots} screenshot(s) and {events} metric event(s) to the company collector; {dropped} dropped as the local buffer filled. Company-managed device. List: CTTImeAgent.exe what-collects
